blockingFindings.description: Directly inspected all five V118 views and six current poses. The torso placement fade from the last body contour at 0.975 m to the measured shoulder endpoint raised the applied displacement scale only from 0.00000340 to 0.00013773. The report still records 2,718 within-panel posterior edges, 26 baseline edges above 60 degrees, and a 179.10-degree maximum. The back remains visibly faceted; this transition is insufficient and the posterior geometry must be replaced or rebuilt from its panel source.
Directly inspected V118 views: the outfit remains almost entirely white with a narrow lilac diagonal chest strip and sparse piping. Lamé response and fencing-practice identity are still not legible.

Directly inspected V118 poses: crouch and sit retain skirt/shorts intersections and abrupt folds; prone retains a broad disk-like skirt flare. Avatar fit, final skin weights, Shape Key response, validated UVs, Unity/VRChat execution and package eligibility remain unverified.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
